_comment: First-person clips for the game, generated by .github/workflows/grok-video.yml (xAI video API). No real people, no club badges, no readable text: the game draws names and scores itself. Every clip is vertical (9:16) for phones and should loop.
style: Photorealistic handheld first-person point of view (POV) shot through the eyes of a football head coach, natural slight head movement, shallow depth of field, cinematic broadcast colour grade, night match under floodlights. Generic unbranded kits and tracksuits in plain dark navy and white, no logos, no badges, no sponsor names, no readable text or numbers anywhere, no watermarks. Everyone is an anonymous adult extra, no recognisable real person. Vertical 9:16 framing. The last frame should match the first so the clip loops.

clips.use: background of the pre- and post-match press conference
clips.prompt: POV from the coach's chair at a post-match press conference. In the foreground a table with several microphones and a water bottle, the coach's own hands resting on the table at the bottom of the frame. Facing him, three rows of seated journalists with notebooks and phones raised, photographers at the back, soft camera flashes going off. A journalist in the second row raises a hand to ask a question. Plain dark backdrop behind the press, no sponsor wall.

POV walking out of a stadium players' tunnel towards the pitch. Concrete tunnel walls, players in plain dark navy kits walking just ahead with their backs to the camera, the bright floodlit pitch and a roaring full crowd opening up at the end of the tunnel, light haze, confetti drifting. The camera steps forward steadily onto the grass.

clips.use: live match, coach's-eye view when the game is paused for a decision
clips.prompt: POV standing in the technical area on the touchline during a night match. The edge of the white touchline and the grass at the bottom of the frame, play happening in the middle distance with two teams in plain dark navy and plain white kits, a full stand of fans behind them, floodlights flaring. The coach's hand comes up into frame and points, giving an instruction.

POV of a coach giving a half-time team talk in a modern dressing room. Tired players in plain dark navy kits sit on benches along the wall, towels on shoulders, drinking water, all looking up at the camera and listening. A blank tactics board on the wall with no writing. The coach's hand gestures in the foreground, calm and intense mood, steam and warm lights.

clips.use: after a goal by my team
clips.prompt: POV from the touchline as the coach's team scores. Players in plain dark navy kits sprint towards the camera with arms wide open and shouting with joy, substitutes jumping at the edge of the frame, the crowd behind erupting, the coach's own fists pumping into the bottom of the frame.

clips.use: winning a cup or the league
clips.prompt: POV of a coach on a winner's podium at night. His two hands lift a plain silver football trophy with no engraving up into the frame, golden confetti raining, fireworks, his players in plain dark navy kits around him cheering and reaching for the trophy, a full stadium in the background.

clips.use: signing a player or the manager's own contract
clips.prompt: POV sitting at a boardroom desk signing a contract. A blank white document on the desk, the coach's hand holding a pen signs at the bottom, across the desk an anonymous club official in a dark suit smiles and reaches out for a handshake. A plain football shirt in dark navy with no badge lies folded on the desk. Warm office lighting, city lights through the window.

POV walking slowly along the touchline towards the tunnel after a defeat, rain falling, looking down at wet grass and then up at emptying stands, a dejected player in a plain dark navy kit walks past with his head down, floodlights reflected in puddles, muted cold colours.
